utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll swing by the repair drive later and see what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Ira. Just let me know what you find and we’ll go from there.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Will do — I’m headed out now, and I’ll text you when I’ve checked it out.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I’m in — what do you need from me for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Could you help sort donations and keep an eye on the drop-off table?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I can do that — just tell me when and where I should be.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Are we definitely still doing the repair drive today?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I think so, but I’d like to double-check the timing and who’s bringing what before we commit.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Right — can you confirm the time and who’s bringing what?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive! I’d love to help, though I may need a little reminder on what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: We still need tools, a few spare parts, and someone to sort the donations. I can make a quick list if you want.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yes, please—make the list and I’ll handle what I can. I’m happy to sort donations too, once I know where to start.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you remind me of the repair drive details first? I want to make sure I’ve got everything right before I do anything.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Uh, right — I think it’s the repair drive for folks in the neighborhood, but I’m a bit fuzzy on the exact details. If you want, I can try to check and get back to you.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Noah — please check the details and let me know. I’d rather confirm everything before I help out.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m in a bit late, but I can help with the repair drive. What still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect timing — we could still use help sorting supplies and matching folks with tasks. Want to take a quick look with me?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Absolutely, let’s do it — I can help sort supplies and line people up with tasks.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing, Gus — what kind of repairs are we looking at for the drive?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Mostly small stuff — loose hinges, squeaky doors, that sort of thing. If you need tools, I’ve got a few you can borrow.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Perfect, I can help with that. I’ll bring by a screwdriver and some oil, and we can get those squeaks sorted out.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m keeping an eye on the repair drive details—do you know where it’s set up today?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I’m not sure yet, but I can check around the school office or the flyer board and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Faye — I’d appreciate that. If you find it, just tell me the exact spot and I’ll head over.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is starting up soon, and folks are already dropping off tools and supplies. If you’re thinking of helping, I can tell you where they’re collecting everything.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely, I’d love that—point me to the drop-off spot and I’ll spread the word to a few neighbors too.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: It’s at the community center parking lot by the library—there’s a big banner on the fence, so you can’t miss it. If you tell your neighbors, they’ll probably be glad to know they’re taking hand tools, paint, and unopened supplies.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it — are we still on for the repair drive this afternoon?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yes, I’m still on for this afternoon. Just tell me what time you want me there.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great — can you be there by 3?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll check with the folks and pass the plan along. If you hear anything new about the repair drive, let me know.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Will do — I’ll keep an ear out and let you know if I hear anything.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Nell — I’ll do the same and keep the plan moving along.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Uli — I’m getting the repair drive organized and can use your help. Would you be able to take on one of the sign-up tasks?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help with one sign-up task, yes. Tell me which one you need me to take.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great — could you handle the volunteer sign-up sheet and keep track of names for me?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive? I heard it’s picking up a few helpers later today. I can swing by and let you know if they need anything else.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That’d be kind of you, Tess. If they need anything, just let me know and I’ll stick to the plan.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Will do, Eli—I'll stop by later and check in with them. If anything changes, I’ll come tell you right away.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late — what do you need me to help with on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: No worries — I need you to help sort the donated tools and then hand out the repair sign-up sheets.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — I’ll sort the donated tools first, then hand out the sign-up sheets.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with that repair drive. What still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rey. I still need to sort the boxes and make one last trip to drop off the parts.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help sort the boxes, and I can do that last drop-off trip too.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — I’m in. Just give me the quick version of what you need done.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great—please head to the repair drive at the community garage on Maple Street. It should only take a quick look, and I’ll be there if you need anything.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — I’ll swing by the community garage on Maple Street now.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help spread the word about the repair drive. What’s the easiest way you’d like me to share it?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Jules — the easiest way is to share the flyer and mention it’s this Saturday at the community hall. If people ask, just tell them to bring one item to fix and arrive a little early.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Got it — I’ll share the flyer and mention Saturday at the community hall, plus the one-item and early arrival note.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — the repair drive. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Noah — could you bring the toolbox and a few spare screws? I’ll organize the sign-in sheet and materials.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sure thing — I’ll grab the toolbox and some spare screws now.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I haven’t heard any updates yet, but I can swing by and check while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Ira—that’d be a big help. If you spot anything, just let me know and I can bring over whatever tools we need.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Will do—I’m heading out now, and I’ll keep an eye out for any repair-drive updates.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing, Leo — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Sam — could you help sort and label the donated items? That’d make the repair drive a lot easier.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, Leo — I can sort and label the donated items. Just let me know where to start.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m happy to help, but I’d like to know the timing and what needs fixing first so we can plan it properly.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good point — let’s start with the roof leak and the broken gate, then we can set a time for Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Saturday morning works for me, as long as we know who’s bringing tools and how long each repair should take.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m in — I’ll spread the word and get folks to the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Quinn — I’ll keep the supplies organized and make sure we’ve got what everyone needs.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, I’ll start inviting people around the block and let them know where to show up.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help with that—what time does the repair drive start, and do we need to work around school pickup?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — I’m pretty sure it starts at 3, but I should double-check that. And yes, we’ll want to work around school pickup if possible.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That sounds good — if it’s at 3, I can probably plan around pickup, but please confirm the time when you can.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, Nell — I’m ready to get the repair drive organized and make sure everyone knows where to turn.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Rosa — I’m still catching up, so any details you can share would really help. I’ll pass them along to the neighbors I’ve heard from.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Of course — I’ll send out the repair drive details and a simple sign-up list so it’s easy to share. If you hear from anyone with a repair need, just send them my way.
